edbDesc: (MOKE) Light reflected from a magnetised surface can change in both polarisation and reflectivity. Identical to the Faraday effect except that the magneto-optical Kerr effect is a measurement of the reflected light, while the Faraday effect is a measurement of the transmitted light. Both effects result from the off-diagonal components of the dielectric tensor e.
title: Magneto-Optic Kerr Effect
pickWhy: The reflected-light version of the Faraday effect; merges into Faraday Effect (another batch).
